title: MAN Lion's City G CNG — reference for the in-game model
vehicle: MAN Lion's City 18 G CNG (articulated, 3 axles, 4 double doors), A23 generation, as seen in the reference photos supplied with the project directive

referencePhotos.view: interior towards the rear (rear section, bellows turntable, seat layout, yellow grab rails)
interior towards the front (driver's cab partition, validators, door 2 area)

length_m.basis: MAN published length for the 18 m articulated Lion's City G (about 18 m); exact value for this configuration not verified

width_m.basis: EU maximum width; MAN city buses are 2.55 m

height_m.basis: including the CNG cylinder housings on the roof; estimated from photo proportions

wheelbase_axle1_axle2_m.basis: estimated from photo proportions against door widths

front_overhang_m.basis: estimated from photos (door 1 ahead of the front axle)

rear_overhang_m.basis: derived so that the sum matches the overall length

tyres.basis: standard city-bus fitment; twin tyres on the driven rear axle

door_width_m.basis: double inward-swinging doors, typical 1.2 m clear opening

engine.value: MAN E2876 LUH, 12.8 l CNG inline-six, about 228 kW (as listed for the NG 313 CNG)
engine.basis: type designation from the A23/NG 313 CNG model range; not verified for the Sofia vehicles. The game uses a generic CNG torque curve, not a certified engine map.

gearbox.value: ZF EcoLife-style 6-speed automatic with torque converter and retarder
gearbox.basis: a common fit for this model; the gearbox behaviour is simulated generically

livery.description: white body, green/yellow/blue leaf graphics of the Sofia public transport livery on the lower body, black window band, amber LED destination signs
livery.basis: recreated as procedural graphics from the reference photos; not a copy of the operator's artwork

doorSequence.implemented: close request -> beep 1 -> beep 2 -> leaves move -> closed; obstruction makes the doors reopen and retry
doorSequence.basis: The two-beep pattern follows the directive. Beep frequency, length and spacing are synthesised and configurable in Settings; they are not a recording of the real bus.

unverified: Exact axle positions and overhangs (estimated from photographs).
Exact seat count and layout in every vehicle (the model uses one plausible layout matching the interior photos).
